extracted.intended_audience: corporate communications, public relations and investor relations professionals seeking newswire distribution and regulatory disclosure services
extracted.subtask_description: Assessing or choosing a commercial newswire service (Business Wire) for distributing full-text press releases, regulatory filings, photos and multimedia worldwide, with targeting, analytics, and regulatory-filing support.

rubrics_metrics.name: Full-text news and multimedia distribution
rubrics_metrics.description: We transmit their full-text news releases, regulatory filings, photos and other multimedia content to journalists, financial professionals, investor services, regulatory authorities and the general public worldwide.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Emphasizes complete-text carriage and distribution to both media and financial/regulatory audiences; implies that effective releases should be prepared as full-text assets with any accompanying multimedia for broad dissemination.

rubrics_metrics.name: Worldwide disclosure and regulatory filing support (EDGAR/SEDAR/UK filings)
rubrics_metrics.description: Business Wire offers services for satisfying regulatory obligations in the US and around the globe. Our in-house EDGAR team - an industry first - makes Business Wire the largest EDGAR filer in the newswire sector. Business Wire also offers Canadian SEDAR and UK Regulatory filings, along with disclosure fulfillment in Belgium, Denmark, Finland, France, Germany, Ireland, the Netherlands, Luxembourg, Sweden and Switzerland.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Service capability for regulatory compliance and official filings; implies that press releases/filings intended for regulated audiences should be formatted and submitted through channels that satisfy jurisdictional disclosure requirements.

rubrics_metrics.name: Targeted industry-segment delivery (Pinpoint News Delivery)
rubrics_metrics.description: In the US, our Business Wire, AutomotiveWire, EntertainmentWire, HealthWire and SportsWire networks offer more than 200 industry segments to provide highly targeted news delivery to relevant audiences.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use industry- or topic-specific channels to reach more relevant journalists and audiences; choose the network/segment that matches the release's sector for better pickup.

rubrics_metrics.name: Issue-specific circuits (CSR and Public Policy)
rubrics_metrics.description: Business Wire also provides services for issue-specific news such as corporate social responsibility and public policy with our CSR Circuit and Public Policy Circuits.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: For specialized topics (e.g., CSR, public policy), route releases through dedicated circuits to reach stakeholders and outlets focused on those issues.

rubrics_metrics.name: Demographic market targeting
rubrics_metrics.description: Demographic markets include Hispanic, African and Asian American.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Target releases to demographic-specific markets when the content is relevant to particular communities to increase resonance and reach.

rubrics_metrics.name: Global media partnerships and language reach
rubrics_metrics.description: Business Wire's worldwide proprietary news network and affiliations with dozens of major news agencies allow companies and organizations to target news releases to more than 145 countries and 45 languages. Business Wire is the only third-party content provider with access to the Associated Press's worldwide media network and the first to gain access to the respected Agence France-Presse media network. In fact, Business Wire is the only commercial newswire that has full-text carriage provisions with all of the world's leading news organizations: Agence France-Presse, Associated Press, Bloomberg, Dow Jones and Reuters.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Broad international reach and syndication partnerships increase the likelihood of pickup in multiple markets and languages; choose providers with deep agency relationships for maximal carriage.

rubrics_metrics.name: Photo and multimedia distribution via Smart News Release
rubrics_metrics.description: Via Business Wire's exclusive Smart News Release platform, text news releases and multimedia content are posted online and distributed to key audiences via the Business Wire network. Photo Smart News Releases are posted directly to Yahoo! Finance, distributed to daily newspapers in the US via the Associated Press photo network and posted to community and industry-based websites. Smart News Release also offers photo distribution to newspapers and media in the UK, Europe and Asia via leading photo agency partnerships.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Include properly formatted photos and multimedia to leverage platform-specific placement (e.g., Yahoo! Finance, AP photo network); using Smart News Release features can increase visibility and placement opportunities.

rubrics_metrics.name: Measurement, monitoring and analytics (NewsTrak)
rubrics_metrics.description: Business Wire's suite of measurement and monitoring services, NewsTrak, provides news release distribution statistics, website posting reports, online viewership data, media clips, media intelligence, reputation management and analytics.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Track distribution performance and media impact with analytics; use metrics (views, clips, pickup) to evaluate effectiveness and inform future release strategy.

rubrics_metrics.name: Trade show and conference partnerships for added exposure
rubrics_metrics.description: Our trade show and conference division... by working with leading industry shows and financial conferences, including having Official Wire status at dozens of them, we provide unique additional exposure for our members' news.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Leverage event partnerships to amplify news around industry gatherings; distribution tied to trade shows can provide targeted exposure to attendees and media covering events.

rubrics_metrics.name: Localized support and rapid turnaround (more newsrooms, accuracy)
rubrics_metrics.description: With more newsrooms than any other commercial newswire, Business Wire provides better local support with fast turnaround of your news releases and greater accuracy.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Local newsroom presence and personalized customer service can improve speed, accuracy, and relevance of distribution—valuable for time-sensitive or location-specific announcements.
